strings.INSTALLER_LAUNCH_FAILED: DeepSeek Harness could not be launched. Retry, or clear Launch now and close the installer.
strings.INSTALLER_UI_ERROR: The installer could not initialize its window. Close it and try again.
strings.INSTALLER_FAILED: Installation did not finish. Close this installer and retry. If the problem persists, download the installer again.
strings.INSTALLER_RUNNING: DeepSeek Harness is running. Quit it from the system tray and try again.
strings.INSTALLER_DIRECTORY_FAILED: The installation directory could not be replaced.
strings.INSTALLER_DIRECTORY_HINT: Check access to the installation directory and close programs using its files, then run the installer again. Copy the error details if the problem persists.
strings.INSTALLER_DIRECTORY_RESTORE_HINT: The previous installation could not be restored. Keep the backup directory shown in the error details and contact support before installing again.
strings.INSTALLER_PATH_INVALID: Choose a full local folder path. Drive roots, system folders, links and special characters are not supported.
strings.INSTALLER_PATH_OWNERSHIP: Choose an empty folder or the registered DeepSeek Harness installation folder.
strings.INSTALLER_PATH_WRITABLE: This location is not writable. Choose a folder available to the current user.
strings.INSTALLER_DISK_SPACE: There is not enough free disk space. Choose another location.
strings.INSTALLER_PER_USER: This installer supports the current user only. Uninstall the existing all-users installation first.
strings.INSTALLER_EXTRACT_FAILED: The application files could not be extracted.
strings.INSTALLER_EXTRACT_HINT: Security software may have blocked a file, or the disk may be full. Close this installer and try again. If it keeps failing, send us the error details below.
strings.INSTALLER_EXTRACT_SAVED: The full report was saved to %s
strings.INSTALLER_EXTRACT_UNSAVED: The full report could not be saved. Use Copy error details to keep it.
strings.INSTALLER_EXTRACT_COPIED: Error details were copied to the clipboard.
